title: Why Your Browser Should Fit You
summary: Your browser holds your passwords, your payment details – nearly everything you do online. But for most people, it’s whatever came with the laptop or phone. Things are changing though: according to our new research, Gen Z is leading the charge to ditch the default, with 85% open to considering a browser designed around their […]
body_markdown:
• Gaming is king: 48% of Gen Z want a browser built for gaming, versus 30% of Millennials and 22% of Gen X.


• But it’s far from the only thing that’s important: Gen Z leads every generation in wanting browsers built around music and entertainment (38%), creative work (32%) and school or studying (26%).


• One browser isn’t enough: 48% of Gen Z regularly use more than one, and 39% of those keep one for gaming or streaming. Only 14% of Gen X do.
